Specifically, the input histological images and gene expression profiles are processed by modality-specific encoders. Gene expression profiles are transformed into gene virtual tokens via a gene encoder, a Q-Former module, and a projection layer. The virtual tokens are then projected into the hidden dimension of the language model and inserted into placeholders, thereby forming a unified input embedding sequence.
